items.title: 喜欢的参考
items.text: 三五张你喜欢的页面或海报截图。来源不限——竞品、别的行业都行，只要那个「感觉」对。

items.title: 不喜欢的反例
items.text: 放一张明确不要的方向并标出来。AI 很会模仿，给它排除项比给它形容词有用。

items.title: 主色和关键词
items.text: 圈出想用的颜色，写两三个氛围词（比如「安静」「纸质感」）。图定大方向，词补细节。

modules.title: 它不是什么
modules.text: 情绪板不是线框图——它定「什么感觉」，不定「哪里放什么」，两者先后使用：先板子对齐方向，再线框排结构。参考也不等于要抄的模板：跟 AI 说「学它的氛围，不要照搬布局」。AI 生成的图也可以当参考，但真实网站截图往往更接近能落地的效果。

lessonPractice.title: AI 做的官网风格总和你想的不一样，来回改了四轮。下面哪个做法最可能一次对齐方向？

options.label: 拼三张喜欢的网站截图加一张不喜欢的，一起发给 AI
options.feedback: 对。图比形容词准——喜欢的划定方向，不喜欢的划清边界，AI 照着做偏差最小。方向问题在拼图阶段就能解决，不用等到做完再改。

options.label: 继续用文字描述：「再高级一点，再简洁一点」
options.feedback: 「高级」「简洁」没有共同标准，你和 AI 各猜各的，第五轮还会偏。

options.label: 让 AI 随机出五版配色，挑一个顺眼的
options.feedback: 碰运气出的五版都建立在你没说清的方向上，挑中也只是巧合。

en.title: The AI's site style keeps missing what you want after four rounds. Which move most likely aligns it in one shot?

options.label: Paste three screenshots you like plus one you dislike, and send them together
options.feedback: Correct. Likes set the direction, the crossed-out one draws the boundary. Solving direction at the collage stage avoids redoing finished work.

options.label: Keep describing in words: "more premium, more minimal"
options.feedback: "Premium" and "minimal" have no shared definition; round five will drift the same way.

options.label: Have the AI generate five random palettes and pick a good one
options.feedback: All five build on an unstated direction; picking a hit would be luck, not alignment.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 按我发的参考图方向做：喜欢的前三张定感觉，标叉的那张要避开，主色用我圈出的那个。做完先给我看首屏的截图再继续。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Follow the references I sent: the three liked ones set the feel, avoid the crossed-out one, and use the main color I circled. Show me a hero screenshot before continuing.

learning.assumes: You have saved screenshots of websites you like, or sent a "make it feel like this" image to a designer.
learning.outcome: You can replace adjectives with a reference collage, and include dislikes to draw the boundary.

items.title: Liked references
items.text: Three to five screenshots of pages or posters you like. Any source works—competitors or other industries—so long as the "feeling" is right.

items.title: Disliked counter-examples
items.text: Include one clearly wrong direction and mark it. AIs are great imitators; exclusions help more than adjectives.

items.title: Main color and keywords
items.text: Circle the color to use and write two or three mood words ("quiet," "paper-like"). Images set the direction; words refine it.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: A moodboard is not a wireframe—it fixes "what feeling," not "what goes where"; use them in sequence: board for direction, wireframe for structure. References are not templates to copy: tell the AI "capture the mood, don't copy the layout." AI-generated images can serve as references too, though real site screenshots often land closer to buildable results.

distinctions.label: Wireframe
distinctions.text: {c:wireframe} settles structure—what sits where; {c:moodboard} settles feeling—what it should look like before that.

distinctions.label: Minimalism
distinctions.text: {c:style-minimal} is one concrete style; {c:moodboard} is the tool for choosing whichever style fits, references included.
